title: Among molecules that contain at least one oxygen atom and at least one doub
question: Among molecules that contain at least one oxygen atom and at least one double bond (not necessarily involving the same atom), which carcinogenic status ('+' or '-') is more common?

prediction.sql:
SELECT m.XCL_011
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (
    SELECT a.XCL_002
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'o'
)
AND m.XCL_010 IN (
    SELECT b.XCL_005
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '='
)
GROUP BY m.XCL_011
ORDER BY COUNT(m.XCL_010) DESC
LIMIT 1
